stages.method_en: Apply in a ring 5–10cm from the stem or in furrows at planting time
stages.method_ha: Zuba a zagaye santimita 5–10 daga tushen shuka ko a cikin rami a lokacin shuka
stages.timing_en: Apply at planting before covering seeds with soil
stages.timing_ha: Zuba kafin a rufe iri da ƙasa
stages.tip_en: Mix fertilizer thoroughly with soil to avoid root burn
stages.tip_ha: Haɗa taki da ƙasa sosai don hana ƙonewar saiwar shuka

stages.method_en: Apply as top dressing in a ring around plants, 10cm from stem. Water after application
stages.method_ha: Zuba a saman ƙasa a zagaye shuka, santimita 10 daga gare ta. Dama ruwa bayan zuba
stages.timing_en: Apply when plant has 6–8 leaves (knee height)
stages.timing_ha: Zuba lokacin shuka ta kai ganye 6–8 (tsayin gwiwa)
stages.tip_en: Apply early morning or evening to reduce nitrogen loss from evaporation
stages.tip_ha: Zuba da safe ko da yamma don hana asarar nitrogen ta hanyar tururi

stages.method_en: Light top dressing. Avoid direct contact with silks or tassels
stages.method_ha: Zuba kaɗan a saman ƙasa. Guji taɓa furannin shuka
stages.timing_en: Apply at the start of tasseling before silk emergence
stages.timing_ha: Zuba farkon furanni kafin siliki ya bayyana
stages.tip_en: Do not over-apply at this stage — excess nitrogen reduces grain quality
stages.tip_ha: Kada a zuba da yawa a wannan matakin — nitrogen mai yawa yana rage ingancin hatsi

general_note_en: Total nitrogen requirement for maize is 120–150 kg N/ha. Split applications improve efficiency. Always apply in moist soil.
general_note_ha: Jimlar buƙatar nitrogen don masara ita ce kilogiram 120–150 N/ha. Raba allurai don inganta amfani. Koyaushe a zuba a ƙasa mai ɗanshi.
sourcing_en: NPK 15-15-15 and Urea are widely available from Notore, Dangote Agro, and government subsidy programs (ADP). Budget ₦25,000–₦40,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: NPK 15-15-15 da Urea ana samun su a Notore, Dangote Agro, da shirin tallafin gwamnati (ADP). Kasafin ₦25,000–₦40,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in furrows at planting. Cover with soil before sowing
stages.method_ha: Zuba a cikin rami a lokacin shuka. Rufe da ƙasa kafin a shuka iri
stages.timing_en: At planting, same day as sowing
stages.timing_ha: A lokacin shuka, ranar da ake shuka
stages.tip_en: Millet requires less fertilizer than maize — do not over-apply
stages.tip_ha: Gero yana buƙatar ƙarancin taki fiye da masara — kada a zuba da yawa

stages.method_en: Top dress around base of plant. Water immediately after
stages.method_ha: Zuba a saman ƙasa kusa da tushen shuka. Dama ruwa nan da nan
stages.timing_en: 4–5 weeks after planting when plants are about 30cm tall
stages.timing_ha: Mako 4–5 bayan shuka lokacin shuka ta kai santimita 30
stages.tip_en: Apply during early morning to reduce nitrogen volatilization
stages.tip_ha: Zuba da safe don rage asarar nitrogen ta tururi

general_note_en: Millet is drought-tolerant and thrives in sandy soils with low fertility. Excess fertilizer can cause lodging. Target 60–80 kg N/ha total.
general_note_ha: Gero yana jure fari kuma yana tsirar a ƙasa mai yashi da ƙarancin haihuwa. Taki mai yawa na iya sa shuka ta faɗi. Nemi kilogiram 60–80 N/ha gaba ɗaya.
sourcing_en: NPK and Urea available at government ADPs and local agro-input dealers. Budget ₦15,000–₦22,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: NPK da Urea ana samun su a ADPs na gwamnati da kantunan taki na gida. Kasafin ₦15,000–₦22,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Place in furrows 5cm deep beside seed rows. Cover before sowing
stages.method_ha: Zuba a cikin rami santimita 5 a gefen layin iri. Rufe kafin shuka
stages.tip_en: Good phosphorus at planting promotes strong root development
stages.tip_ha: Phosphorus mai kyau a lokacin shuka yana inganta saiwar tushe

stages.method_en: Broadcast or band apply 10cm from stem. Water in if no rain
stages.method_ha: Yada ko zuba layi santimita 10 daga tushen shuka. Dama ruwa idan babu ruwan sama
stages.tip_en: Sorghum responds well to nitrogen — do not skip the top dressing
stages.tip_ha: Dawa tana amsa nitrogen sosai — kada a tsallake zuba na biyu

general_note_en: Sorghum is tolerant of drought and poor soils. Target 80–100 kg N/ha. Avoid applying fertilizer in waterlogged conditions.
general_note_ha: Dawa na jure fari da ƙasa mai ƙarancin haihuwa. Nemi kilogiram 80–100 N/ha. Guji zuba taki a ƙasa mai ambaliyar ruwa.
sourcing_en: NPK 15-15-15 and Urea from Notore or ADP stores. Budget ₦18,000–₦28,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: NPK 15-15-15 da Urea daga Notore ko kantunan ADP. Kasafin ₦18,000–₦28,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Broadcast and incorporate into soil before planting
stages.method_ha: Yada a saman ƙasa a haɗa kafin shuka
stages.timing_en: Apply 1–2 weeks before planting or at planting
stages.timing_ha: Zuba mako 1–2 kafin shuka ko a lokacin shuka
stages.tip_en: Groundnut fixes its own nitrogen — avoid heavy N fertilizer. Focus on phosphorus and calcium
stages.tip_ha: Gyada na ɗaure nitrogen da kanta — guji taki mai yawan N. Mai da hankali ga phosphorus da calcium

stages.method_en: Broadcast gypsum directly over the pegging zone around plants
stages.method_ha: Yada gypsum kai tsaye a yankin ƙulle kusa da shuke-shuke
stages.timing_en: At the start of pegging (when flowers touch soil)
stages.timing_ha: Farkon ƙulle (lokacin da furanni suka taɓa ƙasa)
stages.tip_en: Gypsum prevents empty pods and improves kernel filling
stages.tip_ha: Gypsum yana hana fanko a cikin kwafin kuma yana inganta cikawa

general_note_en: Groundnut is a legume — it fixes nitrogen from the air. Prioritize phosphorus, calcium (gypsum), and potassium. Avoid excess nitrogen which promotes leaves over pods.
general_note_ha: Gyada legume ce — tana ɗaure nitrogen daga iska. Ba da fifiko ga phosphorus, calcium (gypsum), da potassium. Guji nitrogen mai yawa wanda yakan inganta ganye fiye da kwafi.
sourcing_en: SSP and Gypsum available at agro-input dealers. Budget ₦20,000–₦35,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: SSP da Gypsum ana samun su a kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦20,000–₦35,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in rows beside transplanted seedlings, 5cm from roots
stages.method_ha: Zuba a layi kusa da saiwar da aka dasa, santimita 5 daga saiwa
stages.tip_en: Good phosphorus at transplanting promotes root establishment
stages.tip_ha: Phosphorus mai kyau yayin dasa yana inganta tsugunnar saiwa

stages.quantity_en: 75 kg Urea + 75 kg MOP per hectare
stages.quantity_ha: Kilogiram 75 Urea + kilogiram 75 MOP a kowace hekta
stages.method_en: Band apply beside rows 8cm from plants. Water immediately
stages.method_ha: Zuba layi kusa da jere santimita 8 daga shuke-shuke. Dama ruwa nan da nan
stages.timing_en: When bulbing begins — plant tops still upright
stages.timing_ha: Lokacin da bulb ya fara — saman shuka har yanzu tsaye
stages.tip_en: Potassium improves bulb size, skin quality and storability
stages.tip_ha: Potassium yana inganta girman bulb, ingancin fata, da iyawar ajiya

stages.method_en: Light top dressing. Reduce irrigation 2 weeks before harvest
stages.method_ha: Zuba kaɗan a saman ƙasa. Rage ban ruwa mako 2 kafin girbi
stages.timing_en: Week 8–10, stop all fertilizer 3 weeks before harvest
stages.timing_ha: Mako 8–10, tsaya daga duk taki mako 3 kafin girbi
stages.tip_en: Stop fertilizer at least 3 weeks before harvest for better taste and storage
stages.tip_ha: Tsaya daga taki aƙalla mako 3 kafin girbi don ɗanɗano da ajiya mafi kyau

general_note_en: Onion is a heavy feeder especially for nitrogen and potassium. Total requirement: 100–120 kg N/ha, 80–100 kg K2O/ha. Good drainage is critical.
general_note_ha: Albasa tana buƙatar taki sosai musamman nitrogen da potassium. Jimlar buƙata: kilogiram 100–120 N/ha, kilogiram 80–100 K2O/ha. Zubewa mai kyau yana da muhimmanci.
sourcing_en: NPK, Urea, MOP available at agro-dealers in Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi markets. Budget ₦35,000–₦55,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: NPK, Urea, MOP ana samun su a kantunan taki a kasuwannin Kano, Sokoto, Kebbi. Kasafin ₦35,000–₦55,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in holes before transplanting seedlings, cover with soil
stages.method_ha: Zuba a cikin rami kafin dasa saiwa, rufe da ƙasa
stages.timing_ha: Kwana 1–2 kafin ko a lokacin dasa
stages.tip_en: Phosphorus promotes strong root development at transplanting
stages.tip_ha: Phosphorus yana inganta saiwar tushe yayin dasa

stages.method_en: Top dress in a ring 10cm from the stem. Water after application
stages.method_ha: Zuba a saman ƙasa a zagaye santimita 10 daga tushen shuka. Dama ruwa bayan zuba
stages.tip_en: Avoid excess nitrogen which promotes leaf growth at expense of fruits
stages.tip_ha: Guji nitrogen mai yawa wanda yakan inganta ganye fiye da 'ya'ya

stages.quantity_en: 100 kg NPK 12-12-17 or 50 kg MOP + 50 kg CAN per hectare
stages.quantity_ha: Kilogiram 100 NPK 12-12-17 ko kilogiram 50 MOP + kilogiram 50 CAN a kowace hekta
stages.method_en: Apply as top dress or fertigation if drip irrigation available
stages.method_ha: Zuba a saman ƙasa ko ta ban ruwa idan akwai tsarin ban ruwa
stages.tip_en: High potassium at fruiting improves fruit color, firmness and shelf life
stages.tip_ha: Potassium mai yawa yayin 'ya'ya yana inganta launi, ƙarfi, da daɗewar 'ya'yan

general_note_en: Tomato needs balanced nutrition. Total: 120 kg N/ha, 80 kg P2O5/ha, 150 kg K2O/ha. Calcium (from lime or gypsum) prevents blossom end rot.
general_note_ha: Tumatur yana buƙatar abinci mai daidaito. Jimla: kilogiram 120 N/ha, kilogiram 80 P2O5/ha, kilogiram 150 K2O/ha. Calcium (daga lime ko gypsum) yana hana ruɓewar ƙarshen furanni.
sourcing_en: All fertilizers available at agro-dealers. Budget ₦40,000–₦65,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: Duk takunan ana samun su a kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦40,000–₦65,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in mounds 10–15cm beside the sett before covering
stages.method_ha: Zuba a tulum santimita 10–15 kusa da gudan kafin a rufe
stages.timing_en: At planting, mixed into the mound
stages.timing_ha: A lokacin shuka, a haɗa cikin tulum
stages.tip_en: Do not let fertilizer touch the sett directly — it causes rot
stages.tip_ha: Kada a bar taki ya taɓa gudan kai tsaye — yana sa ruɓewa

stages.quantity_en: 100 kg Urea + 75 kg MOP per hectare
stages.quantity_ha: Kilogiram 100 Urea + kilogiram 75 MOP a kowace hekta
stages.method_en: Apply around the mound base 15cm from the vine. Cover with soil
stages.method_ha: Zuba a kusa da tushen tulum santimita 15 daga kudar shuka. Rufe da ƙasa
stages.tip_en: Potassium is critical for tuber development and starch accumulation
stages.tip_ha: Potassium yana da muhimmanci wajen girma da tattara sitaci a cikin doya

general_note_en: Yam requires well-drained, deep, loamy soil. Target 80–120 kg N/ha, 60 kg P/ha, 100 kg K/ha. Organic matter (compost) greatly improves yields.
general_note_ha: Doya tana buƙatar ƙasa mai zurfi, mai gudana, mai ɗanshi. Nemi kilogiram 80–120 N/ha, kilogiram 60 P/ha, kilogiram 100 K/ha. Kwayoyin halitta (taki na gargajiya) suna inganta yawan girbi.
sourcing_en: NPK, Urea, MOP from ADP and agro-dealers. Budget ₦30,000–₦50,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: NPK, Urea, MOP daga ADP da kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦30,000–₦50,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in holes before planting stems. Cover well with soil
stages.method_ha: Zuba a cikin rami kafin dasa sanduna. Rufe da ƙasa sosai
stages.timing_en: 2–4 weeks after planting when sprouts appear
stages.timing_ha: Mako 2–4 bayan shuka lokacin da fara ta bayyana
stages.tip_en: Cassava responds strongly to potassium — good K improves starch content
stages.tip_ha: Rogo yana amsa potassium sosai — K mai kyau yana inganta sitaci

stages.method_en: Ring application 15–20cm from stem base
stages.method_ha: Zuba zagaye santimita 15–20 daga tushen shuka
stages.tip_en: Do not apply nitrogen after month 4 — it promotes leaves over tubers
stages.tip_ha: Kada a zuba nitrogen bayan wata 4 — yana inganta ganye fiye da tubers

general_note_en: Cassava can tolerate poor soils but responds well to fertilizer. Target 80 kg N/ha, 60 kg P2O5/ha, 120 kg K2O/ha. Never apply fertilizer in dry soil.
general_note_ha: Rogo na iya jure ƙasa mai ƙarancin haihuwa amma yana amsa taki sosai. Nemi kilogiram 80 N/ha, kilogiram 60 P2O5/ha, kilogiram 120 K2O/ha. Kada a zuba taki a ƙasa mai bushewa.
sourcing_en: Widely available fertilizers from Notore, ADP. Budget ₦20,000–₦35,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: Takunan da ake samu kwarai daga Notore, ADP. Kasafin ₦20,000–₦35,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.quantity_en: 200 kg SSP per hectare + seed inoculant
stages.quantity_ha: Kilogiram 200 SSP a kowace hekta + cuta ta iri
stages.method_en: Apply SSP in furrows. Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium before planting
stages.method_ha: Zuba SSP a cikin rami. A shafa iri da Rhizobium kafin shuka
stages.timing_en: At planting. Inoculate seeds same day as planting
stages.timing_ha: A lokacin shuka. Shafa iri ranar shuka
stages.tip_en: Rhizobium inoculant fixes nitrogen naturally — reduces fertilizer cost significantly
stages.tip_ha: Rhizobium yana ɗaure nitrogen kai tsaye — yana rage farashi na taki sosai

stages.method_en: Band apply beside rows. Avoid direct contact with stems
stages.method_ha: Zuba layi kusa da jere. Guji taɓa tushen shuka
stages.tip_en: Potassium at flowering improves pod fill and seed quality
stages.tip_ha: Potassium a lokacin furanni yana inganta cikawa da ingancin iri

general_note_en: Soybean fixes its own nitrogen via Rhizobium. Prioritize phosphorus at planting and potassium at flowering. Avoid heavy N application.
general_note_ha: Wake Soya yana ɗaure nitrogen ta Rhizobium. Ba da fifiko ga phosphorus a lokacin shuka da potassium a lokacin furanni. Guji yawan zuba N.
sourcing_en: Rhizobium inoculant from IITA or SEEDAN. SSP and MOP from agro-dealers. Budget ₦18,000–₦30,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: Rhizobium daga IITA ko SEEDAN. SSP da MOP daga kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦18,000–₦30,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Broadcast and incorporate into flooded paddies or apply in rows for upland rice
stages.method_ha: Yada a cikin gona mai ruwa ko a zuba layi don shinkafar tudu
stages.timing_en: At transplanting or 1 week after direct seeding
stages.timing_ha: A lokacin dasa ko mako 1 bayan shuka kai tsaye
stages.tip_en: For lowland rice, apply before flooding to improve uptake
stages.tip_ha: Don shinkafar ƙasa, zuba kafin ambaliya don inganta sha

stages.method_en: Broadcast on wet soil or flooded paddies
stages.method_ha: Yada a kan ƙasa mai ɗanshi ko gona mai ruwa
stages.tip_en: Urea in flooded paddies reduces volatilization — apply into shallow water
stages.tip_ha: Urea a gona mai ruwa yana rage asara — zuba cikin ruwa mai zurfi kaɗan

stages.method_en: Top dress lightly. Maintain 5cm water depth after application
stages.method_ha: Zuba kaɗan a saman. Kula da zurfi santimita 5 na ruwa bayan zuba
stages.timing_en: When panicles are just beginning to initiate
stages.timing_ha: Lokacin da haɓaka ya fara samuwa
stages.tip_en: This nitrogen application directly improves grain number and weight
stages.tip_ha: Wannan zuba nitrogen yana inganta yawan hatsi da nauyi kai tsaye

general_note_en: Rice requires 80–120 kg N/ha for lowland, 60–90 kg N/ha for upland. Sulfur deficiency is common in Nigerian soils — use Ammonium Sulphate occasionally.
general_note_ha: Shinkafa tana buƙatar kilogiram 80–120 N/ha don ƙasa, kilogiram 60–90 N/ha don tudu. Ƙarancin sulfur ya zama ruwan dare a ƙasar Nigeria — yi amfani da Ammonium Sulphate lokaci-lokaci.
sourcing_en: All inputs from Notore, ADP, and Kebbi State agro programs. Budget ₦30,000–₦50,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: Duk kayayyaki daga Notore, ADP, da shirye-shiryen noma na Jihar Kebbi. Kasafin ₦30,000–₦50,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in furrows before planting. Do not allow direct contact with seeds
stages.method_ha: Zuba a cikin rami kafin shuka. Kada a bar iri ya taɓa taki
stages.tip_en: Beans fix nitrogen — focus on starter phosphorus for root development
stages.tip_ha: Wake yana ɗaure nitrogen — mai da hankali ga phosphorus don saiwar tushe

stages.method_en: Band apply beside rows. Keep away from stems
stages.method_ha: Zuba layi kusa da jere. Sanya nesa da tushe
stages.tip_en: Avoid nitrogen fertilizer at flowering — it delays pod formation
stages.tip_ha: Guji taki nitrogen a lokacin furanni — yana jinkirta samuwar kwafi

general_note_en: Beans fix nitrogen from air. Primarily need phosphorus (60–80 kg P2O5/ha) and potassium (60 kg K2O/ha). Rhizobium inoculant greatly improves yields.
general_note_ha: Wake yana ɗaure nitrogen daga iska. Yana buƙatar phosphorus (kilogiram 60–80 P2O5/ha) da potassium (kilogiram 60 K2O/ha) ne musamman. Rhizobium yana inganta yawan girbi sosai.
sourcing_en: SSP and MOP from agro-dealers. Budget ₦15,000–₦25,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: SSP da MOP daga kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦15,000–₦25,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.quantity_en: 10–15 tonnes compost + 200 kg NPK per hectare
stages.quantity_ha: Tan 10–15 taki na gargajiya + kilogiram 200 NPK a kowace hekta
stages.method_en: Mix compost into planting beds. Apply NPK in furrows beside rhizomes
stages.method_ha: Haɗa taki na gargajiya a cikin gadajen shuka. Zuba NPK a cikin rami kusa da rhizome
stages.timing_en: Before planting or at planting time
stages.timing_ha: Kafin shuka ko a lokacin shuka
stages.tip_en: Ginger thrives in well-drained, organic-rich soil. Compost is more important than chemical fertilizer
stages.tip_ha: Citta tana tsirar sosai a ƙasa mai gudana da kwayoyin halitta. Taki na gargajiya ya fi muhimmanci fiye da taki na sinadarai

stages.quantity_en: 75 kg Urea + 75 kg MOP per hectare
stages.quantity_ha: Kilogiram 75 Urea + kilogiram 75 MOP a kowace hekta
stages.method_en: Side dress beside rows. Mound soil around rhizomes after application
stages.method_ha: Zuba a gefen layi. Tara ƙasa a kusa da rhizome bayan zuba
stages.tip_en: Mulching with dry grass after fertilizing retains moisture and improves yields
stages.tip_ha: Rufe da ciyawa bayan zuba taki yana riƙe ɗanshi kuma yana inganta yawan girbi

general_note_en: Ginger is a high-value crop that responds very well to organic matter. Target 80 kg N/ha, 60 kg P/ha, 120 kg K/ha. Shade and mulch are key to good yields.
general_note_ha: Citta amfanin gona ne mai daraja mai yawa wanda ke amsa kwayoyin halitta sosai. Nemi kilogiram 80 N/ha, kilogiram 60 P/ha, kilogiram 120 K/ha. Inuwa da mulch sune mabuɗi na yawan girbi mai kyau.
sourcing_en: NPK, Urea, MOP from agro-dealers. Compost from animal manure. Budget ₦40,000–₦70,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: NPK, Urea, MOP daga kantunan taki. Taki na gargajiya daga taki na dabbobi. Kasafin ₦40,000–₦70,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in planting holes mixed with soil. 5–8cm from seed
stages.method_ha: Zuba cikin ramukan shuka a haɗe da ƙasa. Santimita 5–8 daga iri
stages.tip_en: Cucumber needs good nutrition from the start for fast early growth
stages.tip_ha: Kokomba yana buƙatar abinci mai kyau tun farko don girma da sauri

stages.method_en: Top dress around stem base 10cm away. Water after
stages.method_ha: Zuba saman ƙasa kusa da tushe santimita 10 daga shuka. Dama ruwa bayan
stages.tip_en: Cucumbers grow quickly — timely nitrogen ensures strong vine growth
stages.tip_ha: Kokomba yana girma da sauri — nitrogen a lokaci yana tabbatar da ƙarfin kudar shuka

stages.method_en: Band apply beside rows or foliar spray diluted solution
stages.method_ha: Zuba layi kusa da jere ko yi feshi a ganye tare da ruwan da aka naƙalci
stages.tip_en: Adequate potassium at fruiting stage improves cucumber size and quality
stages.tip_ha: Potassium mai isashe a matakin 'ya'ya yana inganta girma da ingancin kokomba

general_note_en: Cucumber is a heavy feeder. Target 120 kg N/ha, 80 kg P/ha, 150 kg K/ha. Ensure regular watering — drought stress greatly reduces yield.
general_note_ha: Kokomba yana cin taki sosai. Nemi kilogiram 120 N/ha, kilogiram 80 P/ha, kilogiram 150 K/ha. Tabbatar da ban ruwa akai-akai — fari yana rage yawan girbi sosai.
sourcing_en: All fertilizers from agro-dealers. Budget ₦35,000–₦55,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: Duk takunan daga kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦35,000–₦55,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.quantity_en: 100–150 g per tree (250–375 kg/ha at 2500 trees/ha)
stages.quantity_ha: Gram 100–150 a kowace bishiya (kilogiram 250–375/ha a bishiyoyi 2500/ha)
stages.method_en: Apply in a ring 50cm from the base of each tree. Incorporate lightly
stages.method_ha: Zuba a zagaye santimita 50 daga tushen kowane bishiya. Haɗa kaɗan
stages.timing_en: Twice yearly — at start of rainy season (April) and mid-season (August)
stages.timing_ha: Sau biyu a shekara — farkon damuna (Afrilu) da tsakiyar damuna (Agusta)
stages.tip_en: Young cocoa trees are sensitive — never exceed recommended dose
stages.tip_ha: Ƙananan bishiyoyin koko suna da sauri — kada a wuce allura da aka ba da shawara

stages.quantity_ha: Gram 300–500 a kowace bishiya a kowace shekara
stages.method_en: Ring application 1m from trunk. Split into 2 applications per year
stages.method_ha: Zuba zagaye mita 1 daga tsohuwa. Raba zuwa allura 2 a kowace shekara
stages.tip_en: Magnesium is essential for photosynthesis in cocoa — do not skip it
stages.tip_ha: Magnesium yana da muhimmanci wajen photosynthesis a koko — kada a yi watsi da shi

general_note_en: Cocoa is a permanent crop — invest in soil health with compost and proper fertilization. Shade trees are essential companions. Zinc deficiency is common in older plantations.
general_note_ha: Koko amfanin gona na dindindin ne — saka hannun jari a lafiyar ƙasa da taki mai kyau. Bishiyoyin inuwa sun zama wajibi. Ƙarancin zinc ya zama ruwan dare a gonaki masu tsofanci.
sourcing_en: Cocoa-specific fertilizers from CRIN, ADP and plantation supply stores. Budget ₦15,000–₦30,000 per hectare per year.
sourcing_ha: Takunan koko musamman daga CRIN, ADP da kantunan gonar dindindin. Kasafin ₦15,000–₦30,000 a kowace hekta a kowace shekara.

stages.quantity_en: 200–300 g NPK per plant + 10 kg compost per planting hole
stages.quantity_ha: Gram 200–300 NPK a kowace shuka + kilogiram 10 taki na gargajiya a kowace rami
stages.method_en: Mix compost into planting hole. Apply NPK in ring 30cm from sucker
stages.method_ha: Haɗa taki na gargajiya cikin rami. Zuba NPK a zagaye santimita 30 daga saiwar shuka
stages.timing_en: At planting and again at 6 weeks
stages.timing_ha: A lokacin shuka da kuma mako 6
stages.tip_en: Plantain thrives with organic matter. Add compost at every fertilizer application
stages.tip_ha: Ayaba tana tsirar da kwayoyin halitta. Ƙara taki na gargajiya a kowace lokacin zuba taki

stages.quantity_en: 150–200 g Urea + 150 g MOP per plant every 2 months
stages.quantity_ha: Gram 150–200 Urea + gram 150 MOP a kowace shuka kowace wata 2
stages.method_en: Ring application 30–50cm from the base. Water after dry weather
stages.method_ha: Zuba zagaye santimita 30–50 daga tushe. Dama ruwa bayan bushewa
stages.timing_en: Every 2 months during the growing season
stages.tip_en: Potassium is the most important nutrient for bunch weight and finger length
stages.tip_ha: Potassium shine abinci mafi muhimmanci don nauyin ɗorawa da tsayin yatsan ayaba

general_note_en: Plantain/banana are heavy potassium feeders. Target 300–400 g K2O per plant per year. Mulching around plants is highly recommended to conserve moisture.
general_note_ha: Ayaba tana cin potassium sosai. Nemi gram 300–400 K2O a kowace shuka a kowace shekara. Ana ba da shawarar rufe ƙasa kusa da shuke-shuke sosai don kiyaye ɗanshi.
sourcing_en: Fertilizers from agro-dealers. Budget ₦20,000–₦40,000 per hectare per year.
sourcing_ha: Takunan daga kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦20,000–₦40,000 a kowace hekta a kowace shekara.

stages.quantity_ha: Gram 5–15 a kowace saiwa a kowace wata
stages.method_en: Apply around base of seedling in polybag. Do not touch seedling stem
stages.method_ha: Zuba kusa da tushen saiwa a cikin jaka. Kada a taɓa tushen saiwa
stages.timing_ha: Kowace wata daga wata 2 zuwa wata 12
stages.tip_en: Begin with low doses and increase gradually as seedling grows
stages.tip_ha: Fara da ƙarancin allura a ƙara kaɗan kaɗan yayin da saiwar take girma

stages.quantity_en: 0.5–1 kg NPK + 0.25 kg Kieserite per palm per application
stages.quantity_ha: Kilogiram 0.5–1 NPK + kilogiram 0.25 Kieserite a kowace kwakwa a kowace zuba
stages.method_en: Broadcast in 1m radius circle around palm base
stages.method_ha: Yada a cikin zagaye da radius mita 1 kusa da tushen kwakwa
stages.timing_ha: Sau biyu a shekara — Afrilu da Satumba
stages.tip_en: Magnesium (Kieserite) prevents orange frond deficiency common in young palms
stages.tip_ha: Magnesium (Kieserite) yana hana ƙarancin launi mai orange wanda ya zama ruwan dare a ƙananan kwakwa

stages.quantity_en: 2–3 kg NPK + 1 kg MOP per palm per year
stages.quantity_ha: Kilogiram 2–3 NPK + kilogiram 1 MOP a kowace kwakwa a kowace shekara
stages.method_en: Broadcast in 2m radius circle. Split into 2 applications per year
stages.method_ha: Yada a cikin zagaye da radius mita 2. Raba zuwa zuba 2 a kowace shekara
stages.tip_en: Leaf analysis every 2–3 years identifies specific nutrient deficiencies in your plantation
stages.tip_ha: Gwajin ganye kowace shekara 2–3 yana gano ƙarancin abinci musamman a gonarka

general_note_en: Oil palm is a long-term investment. Nutrition must be consistent year-round. Potassium, nitrogen, and magnesium are the most critical nutrients.
general_note_ha: Kwakwa saka hannun jari ne na dogon lokaci. Abinci dole ne ya kasance akai-akai a duk shekara. Potassium, nitrogen, da magnesium sune abinci mafi muhimmanci.
sourcing_en: Fertilizers from Notore, ADP, or plantation-supply companies. Budget ₦25,000–₦50,000 per hectare per year.
sourcing_ha: Takunan daga Notore, ADP, ko kamfanonin gonar dindindin. Kasafin ₦25,000–₦50,000 a kowace hekta a kowace shekara.

stages.method_en: Apply in furrows 5cm below seed level. Cover before sowing
stages.method_ha: Zuba a cikin rami santimita 5 ƙarƙashin matakin iri. Rufe kafin shuka
stages.tip_en: Okra grows fast — good starter nutrition is key
stages.tip_ha: Kubewa tana girma da sauri — abinci mai kyau na farko yana da mabuɗi

stages.method_en: Side dress beside rows 8cm from stem. Water after
stages.method_ha: Zuba a gefen layi santimita 8 daga tushe. Dama ruwa bayan
stages.tip_en: Consistent moisture and nutrition keeps okra productive for longer
stages.tip_ha: Ɗanshi da abinci akai-akai suna sa kubewa ta ci gaba da ɗaura 'ya'ya tsawon lokaci

general_note_en: Okra is a light feeder. Target 80–100 kg N/ha, 60 kg P/ha, 80 kg K/ha. Avoid waterlogging — ensure good drainage.
general_note_ha: Kubewa tana cin taki kaɗan. Nemi kilogiram 80–100 N/ha, kilogiram 60 P/ha, kilogiram 80 K/ha. Guji ambaliyar ruwa — tabbatar da gudanar ruwa mai kyau.
sourcing_en: NPK and Urea from agro-dealers. Budget ₦15,000–₦25,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: NPK da Urea daga kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦15,000–₦25,000 a kowace hekta.

stages.method_en: Apply in planting holes mixed with soil, cover before transplanting
stages.method_ha: Zuba a cikin ramukan shuka a haɗe da ƙasa, rufe kafin dasa
stages.timing_ha: Kwana 1–2 kafin ko a lokacin dasa
stages.tip_en: Good phosphorus at transplanting promotes vigorous root growth
stages.tip_ha: Phosphorus mai kyau yayin dasa yana inganta ƙarfin saiwar tushe

stages.method_en: Top dress in a ring 10cm from plant base
stages.method_ha: Zuba a saman ƙasa a zagaye santimita 10 daga tushen shuka
stages.tip_en: Nitrogen promotes leaf and stem growth — do not over-apply
stages.tip_ha: Nitrogen yana inganta ganye da ƙarfin tushe — kada a zuba da yawa

stages.method_en: Top dress or foliar spray. Calcium spray prevents blossom end rot
stages.method_ha: Zuba a saman ƙasa ko yi feshi a ganye. Feshin calcium yana hana ruɓewa a ƙarshen furanni
stages.tip_en: Calcium and boron sprays during fruiting improve pepper quality and reduce disorders
stages.tip_ha: Feshin calcium da boron a lokacin 'ya'ya yana inganta ingancin tattasai kuma yana rage matsaloli

general_note_en: Pepper needs balanced nutrition. Target 120 kg N/ha, 80 kg P/ha, 150 kg K/ha. Calcium is important to prevent physiological disorders. Drip irrigation with fertigation gives best results.
general_note_ha: Tattasai yana buƙatar abinci mai daidaito. Nemi kilogiram 120 N/ha, kilogiram 80 P/ha, kilogiram 150 K/ha. Calcium yana da muhimmanci don hana matsalolin ƙwaƙwalwa. Ban ruwa ta bututu tare da taki yana ba da mafi kyawun sakamakon.
sourcing_en: All fertilizers from agro-dealers. Budget ₦35,000–₦60,000 per hectare.
sourcing_ha: Duk takunan daga kantunan taki. Kasafin ₦35,000–₦60,000 a kowace hekta.
